description: This file defines the RootTabs SwiftUI View component, which manages tabbed navigation within an iOS application. It handles multiple tabs like Screen, Voice, and Settings, and overlays status indicators and toast notifications related to voice wake commands and gateway status. It also interacts with environment objects and manages toast dismissal timing.

classes.name: RootTabs
classes.description: A SwiftUI View managing the main tabbed interface, with overlays for status and notifications, and handling voice wake commands and gateway status.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the SwiftUI view layout including TabView, overlays, and event handling.

methods.name: gatewayStatus
methods.description: Computed property returning the current gateway status as a StatusPill.GatewayState.

methods.name: statusActivity
methods.description: Computed property building the current activity status for the StatusPill.
